supportClaims.label: Honua gRPC FeatureServer discovery
supportClaims.backendNeeded: A Honua Server FeatureService endpoint reachable over gRPC-Web
supportClaims.notes: Discovers a canonical FeatureServer URL through the same REST service/layer metadata geoservices-feature-service discovery uses, deriving capabilities through the identical algorithm, then verifies query/stream through one bounded live QueryFeatures parity probe per layer over the gRPC-Web transport before advertising them; a schema disagreement between the probe and REST metadata fails discovery rather than silently trusting either side.

supportClaims.label: GeoServices FeatureServer query
supportClaims.backendNeeded: Any ArcGIS Server or ArcGIS Online endpoint
supportClaims.notes: Discovers and uses the raw FeatureServer query path; fixture-proven with scheduled anonymous live verification that needs no Honua account or server.

supportClaims.label: GeoServices MapServer reads
supportClaims.backendNeeded: Any ArcGIS Server or ArcGIS Online endpoint
supportClaims.notes: Discovers and uses raw MapServer paths for layer queries, export, identify, legend, find, and cached tiles.

supportClaims.label: GeoServices ImageServer reads
supportClaims.backendNeeded: Any ArcGIS Server or ArcGIS Online endpoint
supportClaims.notes: Discovers ImageServer metadata and creates a Source only when catalog query and pagination support are advertised; export-only imagery remains an operation descriptor.

supportClaims.label: GeoServices GeometryServer discovery
supportClaims.backendNeeded: Any ArcGIS Server GeometryServer endpoint
supportClaims.notes: Returns advertised geometry operations as metadata-only descriptors; it never invents a queryable Source.

supportClaims.label: GeoServices GPServer discovery
supportClaims.backendNeeded: Any ArcGIS Server GPServer endpoint
supportClaims.notes: Returns task execution and job-lifecycle metadata without starting a job or inventing a queryable Source.

supportClaims.label: Esri compatibility layer
supportClaims.backendNeeded: Any ArcGIS Server or ArcGIS Online endpoint
supportClaims.notes: Compatibility classes parse public GeoServices URLs and create their own client.

supportClaims.label: ArcGIS scanner and migration codemod
supportClaims.backendNeeded: None
supportClaims.notes: Static analysis and rewrites run locally; no service is involved.

supportClaims.label: Geometry operations
supportClaims.backendNeeded: None
supportClaims.notes: Buffer, area, simplify, measure, and reprojection run in the client through optional peers.

supportClaims.label: OGC API Features
supportClaims.backendNeeded: Any OGC API Features server
supportClaims.api: connect(), Source with locator.layout=ogc-api or auto
supportClaims.notes: Discovers collections and item links from a raw landing page; the Honua facade remains a zero-round-trip fast path.

supportClaims.label: WFS 2.0
supportClaims.backendNeeded: Any WFS 2.0 server
supportClaims.notes: Uses the DCP operation URLs advertised by GetCapabilities instead of assuming a server path.

supportClaims.label: WMS 1.3 discovery and raster rendering
supportClaims.backendNeeded: Any WMS 1.3.0 server with a MapLibre-compatible GetMap binding
supportClaims.notes: Discovers layers, styles, dimensions, CRS/axis order, formats, and same-origin operation URLs. Raw sources render through the reviewed GetMap binding; canonical query remains disabled unless a Honua service id binds the existing FeatureInfo adapter.

supportClaims.label: WMTS 1.0 discovery and raster tiles
supportClaims.backendNeeded: Any WMTS 1.0.0 server with a Web Mercator, z-addressable tile matrix set
supportClaims.notes: Discovers layers, styles, dimensions, formats, ResourceURL/KVP bindings, and tile matrices. Rendering uses the reviewed binding and fails closed when matrix identifiers cannot map exactly to MapLibre zooms.

supportClaims.label: STAC API and static catalogs
supportClaims.backendNeeded: Any STAC API or static catalog
supportClaims.api: connect(), Source with locator.layout=stac-api or stac-static
supportClaims.notes: Searches a raw STAC API or walks static catalog links with client-side filtering.

supportClaims.label: OData v4
supportClaims.backendNeeded: Any OData v4 service
supportClaims.notes: Reads $metadata, intersects advertised capabilities, and uses the raw service root.

supportClaims.label: PMTiles direct asset discovery
supportClaims.backendNeeded: Any static host with exact HTTP Range and readable CORS headers
supportClaims.notes: Reads only a bounded PMTiles v3 header and metadata range through the authenticated client pipeline; pmtiles:// is the sole direct auto marker, while filename-only and spoofed inputs fail closed without alternate-protocol probing.

supportClaims.label: GeoParquet asset discovery
supportClaims.backendNeeded: None; caller provides a GeoParquet profiler
supportClaims.notes: Profiles one or more assets and returns reviewed Source descriptors; query execution remains injected through the optional GeoParquet resolver.

supportClaims.label: OGC API Tiles
supportClaims.backendNeeded: Any link-driven OGC API Tiles server
supportClaims.notes: Discovers raw landing, conformance, collection, tileset, and tile links; does not rewrite them to /ogc/tiles. Fixture-proven with scheduled anonymous live verification of one bounded vector tile.

supportClaims.label: OGC API Maps
supportClaims.backendNeeded: Any link-driven OGC API Maps server
supportClaims.notes: Discovers and renders from the raw map path advertised by the service; does not require /ogc/maps. Fixture-proven with scheduled anonymous live verification of one bounded PNG render.

supportClaims.label: OGC API Records
supportClaims.backendNeeded: Any link-driven OGC API Records server
supportClaims.notes: Discovers and queries the raw records path advertised by the service; does not require /ogc/records. Fixture-proven with scheduled anonymous live verification of one bounded record page.

supportClaims.label: OGC API Processes discovery
supportClaims.backendNeeded: Any link-driven OGC API Processes server
supportClaims.notes: Discovers conformance and process metadata at raw paths. Processes are not a protocol-neutral Source; scheduled anonymous live verification proves operation-only discovery and a zero-request connect() rejection.

supportClaims.label: OGC API Processes execution
supportClaims.backendNeeded: Honua Server
supportClaims.notes: Typed execution uses the Honua facade today; raw third-party execution is not claimed.

supportClaims.label: Server compatibility gate
supportClaims.backendNeeded: Honua Server
supportClaims.notes: Reads the Honua administrative capabilities contract and should be skipped for standalone reads.

supportClaims.label: Authored MapPackage runtime
supportClaims.backendNeeded: Honua Server
supportClaims.notes: Loads server-authored styles, layer order, and metadata.

supportClaims.label: Realtime subscriptions
supportClaims.backendNeeded: Honua Server
supportClaims.notes: SSE, WebSocket, and OData polling share a release-gated fixture corpus; scheduled evidence executes each transport that Honua Server advertises and classifies unsupported or degraded capability separately.

supportClaims.label: Collaboration and saved maps compatibility shim
supportClaims.backendNeeded: Honua Server and @honua/app-platform
supportClaims.notes: The SDK entrypoint is a temporary shim; new code imports @honua/app-platform/collaboration.

supportClaims.label: MCP tools and AI execution
supportClaims.backendNeeded: Honua Server and @honua/mcp-server
supportClaims.notes: Tool definitions are local, while discovery and query execution use the bounded Honua server surface.
